Aceptamos a quienes gusten ser parte!
summary:
This is an interactive, educational web platform designed for primary and secondary schools, which transforms abandoned NASA equipment and instruments on the Moon and Mars into historical and cultural heritage, using the 5E pedagogical model.
It includes images, an interactive map of both celestial bodies, and a quiz to test your knowledge!
details:
• The Challenge: We tackled the challenge "Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars", recovering the history of the vehicles, probes, and tools that shaped space exploration from a pedagogical perspective that sparks curiosity in the classroom.
  • Pedagogical Approach (5E) and Critical Thinking: The platform guides students from introduction (Engage) to interactive evaluation (Evaluate), including reflective dilemmas (Elaborate) to debate in class whether abandoned equipment is "space debris" or "humanity's historical monuments and museums".
  • Integrated Teacher Support: In addition to the interactive trivia for students, it incorporates a section dedicated exclusively to teachers with key questions and answers ready to use, facilitating lesson planning without requiring prior preparation.
  • Technical Accessibility and Inclusive Design: Developed with native web code (HTML/CSS/JS), it incorporates accessibility best practices (ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, reduced-motion support) and automatic optimization to run smoothly on both mobile phones and low-resource school netbooks or limited connectivity environments.
  • Scalability and Future Impact: Its modular and open-source architecture makes it easy to add new celestial bodies (such as Venus, Titan, or asteroids), incorporate more languages, and allow other teachers or developers to collaborate by expanding the content.
projectRefs: Netlify – Static Web Hosting & Continuous Deployment
Google Gemini – Pedagogical Structuring (5E Model), Content Adaptation & Documentation
Claude AI – Frontend Code Debugging, Responsive Optimization & UI Refinement
